# `workspace` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### workspace.list

**Read workspaces**

List saved project and device contexts.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.list
```

### workspace.save

**Save workspace**

Save a named project, target and optional native test scenario without modifying project sources.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}` |
| `path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `platform` | string |  | `"android"` | one of `android`, `ios`, `web`, `linux` |
| `device` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `bundle_id` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `scenario` | string |  | `""` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.save '{"name":"<name>","path":"<path>"}'
```

### workspace.remove

### workspace.execute

**Run workspace**

Build, test, lint, run or execute the saved UI scenario using the shared native APIs.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `action` | string | yes |  | one of `build`, `test`, `lint`, `run`, `ui_test` |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
